_comment: Last accepted metric values (playbook 16: evaluation is a gate). recorded is false until a real evaluator scores a track and search_eval.py --record writes it here; while a track is not recorded a missing evaluator passes as 'not available yet', afterwards it fails. Metrics: retrieval recall@10 and MRR over eval/retrieval.jsonl; classification accuracy per field over eval/classification.jsonl (change type exact, flags set equality, scope mean Jaccard over the named dimensions, screen = AGT-07 risk flags set equality, in-scope = AGT-08 in_scope equal, standard term = AGT-08 standard_terms set equality). Never edit the numbers by hand: an accepted improvement is re-recorded with --record in the same commit as the change that earned it.
